name: Patron: Old Mossmaw of the Nalwood Deep (Green Hag) (Witch)

system.description:
Every swamp has one, or claims to. Old Mossmaw wears a different lovely face every time she's seen, and every villager who's traded with her swears they got the better deal — until they check what they actually walked away with.

  • Patron Buff (1st): Once per day, grant a touched creature (or yourself) a glamour — +4 to Deception and Persuasion checks for 1 hour, appearance unchanged to true sight or careful magical scrutiny. While the glamour lasts, the first attack made against the recipient in each encounter has Disadvantage.
  • Patron Curse (6th): Once per day, force a creature within 30ft to see themselves as hideous in every reflective surface for 24 hours (Will save negates) — disadvantage on Charisma checks with anyone who has seen their reflection.
  • Physical Change (12th): Your skin takes on a faint mottled green cast in dim light, and warts bloom at your knuckles.
  • Advantage on Stealth checks in swamp, marsh, or bog terrain.
  • Your hands harden with a bog-witch's grip — unarmed strikes deal 1d6 damage and you gain advantage on grapple and overbearing checks.
